verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic SDKs spanning 13 client-side, 13 server-side, and 4 edge platforms, plus OpenFeature provider support for standardized flag evaluation, and a Relay Proxy/streaming architecture for consistent behavior across environments; community confirms mobile client SDK exists and streaming flag delivery works as described. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of behavioral consistency across all SDK types, and community notes that mobile SDK usage is complicated by MAU-based pricing leading some teams to build proxies instead of using it directly.
